technology_name: Biodegradable Cutleries, Cups, Glass and Plates from Agricultural Residues
institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
problem_solved: Dependence on single-use plastic tableware and disposal challenges
description: This technology produces biodegradable cutleries, cups, glasses, and plates from agricultural residues including wheat bran, sugarcane bagasse, rice husk, and fruit peels. The products are heat resistant for a limited duration and can be used as alternatives to single-use plastics. The material is biodegradable and suitable for food service applications.
applications:
Sustainable packaging and biodegradable product manufacturers
Food service, catering, and hospitality businesses
Event management and disposable tableware suppliers
Agro-residue utilization and circular economy enterprises
Government agencies and organizations promoting plastic-free initiatives
secondary_sector: Advanced Materials & Chemical, Water, Environment & Waste Management, Food Technology, Consumer & Lifestyle Products, Agribusiness & Rural Economy
